info.title: FINN initial market data API
info.description: Design contract for a future Java service; no endpoints currently deployed. EOD valuation, explicit missing/stale data and synthetic/private modes only. No trading, broker onboarding, news or investment-performance promises.

servers.description: Same-origin Java API; no running service implied.

x-finn-versioning: Immutable semantic-versioned contract artifact; independent frontend/backend releases record tested contract SHA. Even 0.x breaking changes require compatibility review.

sessionCookie.name: FINN_SESSION
sessionCookie.description: Planned secure HttpOnly session. State-changing endpoints added later require CSRF protection.

DecimalString.description: Exact base-10 decimal; no exponent, separators, or financial JSON numbers.

PositiveDecimalString.description: A present traded price must be positive. Missing price is not zero.

UtcInstant.description: UTC RFC3339 instant. A session date must not be expanded into a fabricated observation time.

ListingIdentity.description: Stable listing identity. NSE and BSE listings remain distinct even for one security. ISIN may be unknown; ticker is not a permanent identifier.

Delay.description: Delay is source-declared or unknown; FINN receipt time is not evidence of zero upstream delay.

Rights.description: A routing restriction, not a legal entitlement. Public real-data distribution is outside this contract's validated modes.

SourceTimes.description: Source and FINN processing times are distinct. Null timestamps require matching unknownTimeReasons; checked by semantic validation.

Provenance.description: No personal local paths, credentials, cookies, private object URLs, or source payloads in public provenance.

PriceObservation.description: One present EOD observation. A missing close is represented by unavailable result and no observation. Partial OHLC/volume stay null. As-traded and adjusted series are never interchangeable.

AcquisitionEnvelope.description: Internal acquisition response: per-listing partial success is explicit. COMPLETE means every requested listing has observations; it does not prove complete date-range coverage.

Freshness.description: Calendar-aware age/eligibility assessment. A weekend does not make the newest expected completed session stale. FRESH requires equal known latest/expected sessions.

Capability.description: A documented library interface does not establish validated Indian listing coverage, timing, or rights.

ProviderCapabilities.description: Exactly one entry per declared capability; uniqueness/completeness are semantic checks.

ProviderStatus.description: Operational status is distinct from market-data freshness. No service SLA or live exchange certification is implied.

Problem.description: RFC9457 problem response. Do not expose stack traces, private rows, tokens, or upstream cookies.

QuoteResponse.description: Latest eligible stored EOD observation, not a tick or a promised live quote. Unavailability is a normal domain result; service/auth failures use Problem.

HistoryCoverage.description: Coverage describes the entire requested range at selectionSnapshotId, not this page. COMPLETE requires a verified calendar, equal expected/available counts, and no missing sessions. availableSessions may exceed the current page length.

HistoryResponse.description: Ascending sessionDate/observationId order. ONE_DAY only. Never fill gaps with zero or a silent previous close. Cursors bind listing, range, basis and source-selection snapshot.

AsyncJobStatus.description: Owner-scoped status snapshot, not a queue implementation. Revision is server-assigned and increases on committed changes. Terminal states are immutable; retry creates a new job. Failure codes are safe application codes, never raw exceptions or source values.
